title: Couple by Automobile, Cloche Hat Fur Collar - Vintage 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp late-1920s outdoor snapshot depicting an elegantly dressed mature woman and a younger man posing beside an open automobile door in an open field or rural roadside. The woman wears round wire-rimmed spectacles, a dark cloche-style hat, and a heavy winter overcoat featuring a deep astrakhan or Persian lamb fur shawl collar accented by a floral corsage. The gentleman beside her is attired in a tailored three-piece wool suit with a vest, a patterned necktie, and has neatly parted hair with his hand casually tucked into his pocket. The composition reflects the growing popular culture of weekend automotive motoring and road trips across rural America during the prosperous Roaring Twenties.
